# Third-party baselines

Clone external baselines here for local reproduction. This directory is ignored by git; record exact repositories and commits in `MANIFEST.md`.

Candidate baselines:

- CADTransformer: https://github.com/VITA-Group/CADTransformer
- SymPoint: https://github.com/nicehuster/SymPoint
- GAT-CADNet reproduction: https://github.com/Liberation-happy/GAT-CADNet
